canonical_project: Campus IA mega AI data center (Fouju)
owner: Societe Campus IA (SPV; president Thibaud Desfosses)
notes: Huge AI datacenter campus near Melun, announced at Choose France 2025 (est. ~50bn EUR). 11 buildings over 24-90 ha, ~86,000 m2 authorized surface. Public enquiry commission gave a favorable report for the building permit on 2026-07-02; ICPE/IOTA authorizations sought with the prefect. First phase delivery targeted 2028 (2033 per developer interview). Strong local/activist opposition.
